# What the bundled Emscripten SDK ships — a KEEP list, read by
# dist/package-toolchain.sh.
#
# A keep list rather than a deny list because the failure directions are not
# symmetric: an upstream tree that grows a directory nobody here has heard of is
# dropped and, if it mattered, fails the packaging's own read-only re-link; a
# deny list would ship it forever and nothing would say so.
#
# Paths are relative to the SDK root and may glob. A directory keeps its whole
# subtree. AN ENTRY MATCHING NOTHING IS FATAL — a renamed upstream path must not
# quietly become an empty keep. Comments take a whole line.
#
# A `windows: ` / `posix: ` prefix scopes a line to that OS's SDK tree; an
# untagged line applies to both. Match-nothing is fatal only where the line
# applies, and any other `<word>:` prefix is an error.
#
# Applied AFTER the cache bake and BEFORE the freeze, so the read-only re-link of
# the three shapes is this file's oracle: an over-trim surfaces as a FROZEN_CACHE
# error naming the file it wanted.
#
# The licence of a package that survives is kept whatever this file says, and
# copied into LICENSES/ at the SDK root — but only when it shares a directory
# with something kept. A text that sits apart from the binary it covers, as a
# baked archive's does from its sources, has to be named here like any other file.

# ── The toolchain binaries ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Every executable emcc, the Emscripten cmake toolchain or a Binaryen pass
# launches by name, plus the symlink families that name it (clang++ -> clang ->
# clang-24, wasm-ld -> lld). Gone with the rest: the front-ends no export path
# runs — clangd, clang-scan-deps, the llvm inspection tools behind
# emnm/emsize/emprofile/emsymbolizer, the Binaryen fuzzers and wasm2js.
posix: bin/clang-24
posix: bin/clang
posix: bin/clang++
posix: bin/lld
posix: bin/wasm-ld
posix: bin/llvm-ar
posix: bin/llvm-ranlib
posix: bin/llvm-nm
posix: bin/llvm-objcopy
posix: bin/llvm-strip
posix: bin/wasm-opt
posix: bin/wasm-as
posix: bin/wasm-dis
posix: bin/wasm-ctor-eval
posix: bin/wasm-emscripten-finalize
posix: bin/wasm-metadce
posix: bin/wasm-split
# The Windows zip ships no symlink families and no versioned clang-24: each
# front-end is one whole .exe.
windows: bin/clang.exe
windows: bin/clang++.exe
windows: bin/lld.exe
windows: bin/wasm-ld.exe
windows: bin/llvm-ar.exe
windows: bin/llvm-ranlib.exe
windows: bin/llvm-nm.exe
windows: bin/llvm-objcopy.exe
windows: bin/llvm-strip.exe
windows: bin/wasm-opt.exe
windows: bin/wasm-as.exe
windows: bin/wasm-dis.exe
windows: bin/wasm-ctor-eval.exe
windows: bin/wasm-emscripten-finalize.exe
windows: bin/wasm-metadce.exe
windows: bin/wasm-split.exe
# emcc.exe is a launcher for emcc.py, run by the pinned portable CPython staged
# beside the toolchain (EMSDK_PYTHON).
windows: python
# clang's own resource directory: the headers every compile names through
# -internal-isystem. The host libc++ archives beside it link host tools.
lib/clang

# ── The emcc driver ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
emscripten/em*
emscripten/*.py
emscripten/*.txt
emscripten/*.json
emscripten/*.toml
emscripten/.emscripten
emscripten/AUTHORS
emscripten/cmake
# src/lib is a -L on every link, not documentation.
emscripten/src
# emscripten/system is absent but for the licence block at the end: it is the
# SOURCE of the system libraries and of the sysroot headers, and a frozen cache
# neither builds one nor re-installs the other — every include path a compile
# names is under cache/sysroot or clang's resource dir.
emscripten/third_party
emscripten/tools

# ── The npm packages emcc loads while linking ────────────────────────────────
# Computed, not listed: node_modules carries emscripten's whole lint/test/bundle
# chain besides, and the runtime closure of emscripten/package.json is the part a
# link can reach. A dependency added upstream therefore ships with no edit here,
# and one that is neither reachable nor declined fails the packaging.
node-closure
# Closure runs only under --closure / -sUSE_CLOSURE_COMPILER. Nothing on this
# lane passes either: the drop-in is a side module with no JS glue to minify,
# and the engine's own Web template is baked through an SDK that is not this one.
node-drop google-closure-compiler

# ── The baked sysroot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Only the sysroot: build/ is the system-library scratch dir the bake wrote, and
# a frozen emcc regenerates the JS symbol info every link rather than reading
# cache/js_output or cache/symbol_lists.
emscripten/cache/sysroot_install.stamp
emscripten/cache/sysroot/bin
emscripten/cache/sysroot/include
emscripten/cache/sysroot/share
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/pkgconfig
# pic/ is what the bake itself built, so it already IS exactly the set the two
# PIC shapes resolve — the side module an export ships and a MAIN_MODULE.
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/pic
# The static half, one archive at a time. Which variant a link resolves is
# decided by the link settings, and this lane fixes all of them: no threads (so
# no -mt/-ww), no sanitizer, assertions off (so no -debug), -fwasm-exceptions
# over legacy EH. A settings change reaching past this list fails the read-only
# re-link naming the archive it wanted, which is why they are named here at all.
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/crt1.o
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/crt1_proxy_main.o
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/crt1_reactor.o
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libal.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libc.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libc++-legacyexcept.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libc++abi-legacyexcept.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libclang_rt.builtins-legacysjlj.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libdlmalloc.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libGL-getprocaddr.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libhtml5.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libnoexit.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libsockets.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libstubs.a
emscripten/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libunwind-legacyexcept.a

# ── The licence text of what those archives were compiled from ───────────────
# Object code ships from here, its text stays in emscripten/system/ with the
# sources — so the file is named, which makes its directory a kept one and puts
# the text in LICENSES/. One line per package the two link shapes RESOLVE:
# llvm-libc, mimalloc and openmp build archives neither reaches, and a text for
# a binary the bundle does not carry claims more than it ships.
emscripten/system/lib/libcxx/LICENSE.TXT
emscripten/system/lib/libcxxabi/LICENSE.TXT
emscripten/system/lib/libunwind/LICENSE.TXT
emscripten/system/lib/compiler-rt/LICENSE.TXT
emscripten/system/lib/libc/musl/COPYRIGHT
